actionable_steps.step: Keep the Name of the Lord always on your tongue and in your mind — this is given specifically to help you give up fear and doubt.
Attach yourself to Him — then your attachment for temporary objects will fall off and they will lose their power to frighten you.

actionable_steps.citation: Complete surrender confers Bliss — SSS Vol 32 (1999), 1999-11-23
actionable_steps.step: Never be afraid of expressing your faith in God — be courageous and bold; give up fear and live in bliss.

actionable_steps.citation: Man And God: Nara And Narayana — SSS Vol 1 (1953 - 60), 1958-07-25
actionable_steps.step: Cultivate love — when you love, you have no fear, and fear is the mother of falsehood.

actionable_steps.citation: Light the lamp within — SSS Vol 24 (1991), 1991-11-05
actionable_steps.step: Practise triple purity of body, mind, and speech — where there is this threefold purity, there will be no fear.

actionable_steps.citation: Learning a lesson from a child — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-01-14
actionable_steps.step: Chant the Lord's name — the one who chants the Lord's name has no fear of worries.

definition.citation: Develop Love for God — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-18
definition.quote: That one has total faith in God and has no fear. Fear is an animal quality. One who causes fear is a beast. One who is fearstricken is an animal. Having been born as humans, you should neither cause fear in others nor be fear-stricken yourself.

discourses.citation: Man And God: Nara And Narayana — SSS Vol 1 (1953 - 60), 1958-07-25
discourses.quote: For it is only when you love that you have no fear, for fear is the mother of falsehood. If you have no fear, you will adhere to truth.

discourses.citation: Inscrutable are the ways of the Lord — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-08-10
discourses.quote: Love God and fear none. Only the guilty need fear. Why fear when you are innocent?

discourses.citation: Atma is the Fundamental Basis of Everything — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-09-10
discourses.quote: How can one be free from fear? Fearlessness is where detachment is... Sankara taught 'Oh man, in order to be free from fear and attain a state of fearlessness, take refuge in the principle of the Atma.'
Fearlessness is the hallmark of divinity... realise that your very nature is absolute fearlessness in all circumstances. Remain true to your nature.

make_it_real: Fear is the lion of the jungle — but love is the clearing. Walk in love, and fear cannot catch you.
title: Fear

vahinis.quote: True aspirants can discern valuable truths in the divine words spoken by the Lord: Abandon all dharmas; Surrender to Me alone. I shall free you from all sins; Do not fear. (Sarva dharmaan parithyajya Maam ekam saranam vraja; Aham thwam sarvapaapebhyo Mokshayishyami, maa suchah)
